subject: A Cargo-native Shepherd release and recovery decision.

dimensions.desc: Publishes shepherd-sdk while preserving the shepherd Rust crate/import, publishes the six-crate dependency closure in order, and excludes shepherd-component.
Compiles unpacked crate artifacts and ships a byte-exact generated compiler corpus without checkout-relative production inputs.
Maps every supported target to immutable versioned Shepherd archives with a root binary and forbids compile or quick-install fallback.
Records local crate checksums, compares existing immutable registry bytes, resumes dependency waves, requires explicit confirmation, and publishes GitHub only after crates are visible.

guidance: Penalize package-list-only evidence, the unrelated shepherd package, checkout-relative includes, filename heuristics, silent Binstall fallback, unverified retries, credential arguments, and GitHub-first publication.
